exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) intervention (screening and management at primary care level)
cohort: 210 pregnant women attending antenatal care in two districts of Morocco
finding: While inconclusive, GDM detection and care through antenatal care at primary health facilities may have positively impacted newborn birthweight.
birth_weight: Intervention group: 147 grams lower than control group (p=0.08)
